coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell or box: its printed edges. Tick box: the printed square.
how_measured: Embedded pictures decoded at their own resolution (pdfimages) and mapped through each image's placement; combs, squares and light rules found as ink components and white cells on grey (picfields.py); text-layer rules from pdfplumber; shadow squares measured on 200 dpi renders; overlays looked at.

third_parties: transferee in the request for transfer (page 21)
signing.kind: Superfund Gold L.P. subscription documents (Exhibit D-G of a prospectus): RIA page, subscription agreement and power of attorney, suitability form with 14 initial boxes, dollar-cost-averaging addendum, request for transfer, additional-investment form and series-exchange form. Form fields are pictures (combs) inside a text PDF. The general partner's acceptance is not a signature place.
signing.note: Combs printed as pictures; each comb (or each group split by dashes or commas) is one place. Several small choice boxes are shadow squares drawn on the text layer.

sure_per_page.4: sure; the RIA rows are captioned "to be completed by registered investment advisor" (third party)
sure_per_page.8: sure of every place; combs split where the printed comb is interrupted (city/state/zip, phone groups)
sure_per_page.14: sure; one grey box at the foot of the left column has no text beside it (kept, marked)
sure_per_page.17: sure; the four small choice boxes are drawn as shadow squares on the text layer (measured on a render)
sure_per_page.21: sure of the places; whose the transferee places are (third party: the person receiving the units) is a judgement
sure_per_page.23: sure; the five choice boxes in the paragraphs are shadow squares measured on a render
